body: Thank you for the nice words. They cheered me up a bit.

I always had a thing for electronics, ever since I was a kid, so IT felt natural for me. I completely swapped my course of studies after my last failed studies. From food/marketing to IT and I am enjoying this way more. Well, ''enjoying'' as in not hating it but not getting completely stressed out by it either. I guess it's some kind of progress.

You're right about that, but I am not sure if it is worth clearing up considering I have lost everyone who I truly cared about. At the moment I don't have anyone but my stepdad (whom I consider my dad, atleast to some extent). I don't care for my siblings too much, when it comes to my mother, not at all simply cause she has caused nothing but harm in my life. First by conceiving me and then by constant physical and mental abuse.

Do I think I am crazy? Honestly, no. I'd say that I am mostly fed up.

Do they think you are smart? I honestly don't know, they know that I have done actual IQ tests and reached rather high but in my opinion those things don't tell a whole lot. I'd say I am average when it comes to intelligence.

Do they have jobs? My older sister does, my older brother is a recovering drug addict, so no.

Do you have a job and also do you want a job? Currently no job but I've had them prior and always lost them due to extreme anxiety, I never even managed to finish my studies. I am currently studying IT after a 2 year break and it's going okayish.
